body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-032-v26-offer-truth-latency-cart.md (builds on SC-030). Change src/savvycart/offercheck.py, src/savvycart/http.py, src/savvycart/static/app.css, and src/savvycart/agent.py (extra_offers only); new tests in tests/test_v26_page.py; the one superseded assertion in tests/test_v25_page.py; a new scripts/live_e2e_check.py for the live check. Do not call Gemini in tests. Cut-off 17:00 Colombo (H6).

Acceptance criteria:
1. Category-limited offers pay only covered items; end dates, networks, unstated combine. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v26_page.py::test_category_limited_offer_pays_only_covered_items tests/test_v26_page.py::test_offer_end_dates_networks_and_unstated_terms -q
2. Why opens instantly; agent on Ask with cache; busy script; plain answers and notices. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v26_page.py::test_why_opens_instantly_and_the_agent_runs_on_ask tests/test_v26_page.py::test_busy_script_and_plain_answers -q
3. Mock cart per store at Approve. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v26_page.py::test_approve_shows_a_mock_cart_per_store -q
4. Plan with a checked card. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v26_page.py::test_plan_with_a_checked_card -q
5. Engine cache, direct approve, versioned CSS. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v26_page.py::test_engine_cache_direct_approve_and_versioned_css -q
6. Live journey. Verify: python scripts/live_e2e_check.py https://savvy-cart-23322909520.asia-southeast1.run.app
7. Every test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q; python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: v2.6 build: truthful category offers, responsive Gemini steps, mock cart, plan with a checked card, leaner calls
